findings.statement: Scope: one bounded replay (run:72cf0e4b91a3; 55 dataset events, 3 of 3 jobs completed, clink exit status 0, not cancelled; fan-in threshold 5 distinct senders in a 3,600,000 ms window; onward max gap 1,800,000 ms). The dataset has 55 transfers, 48 accounts, 35 devices, 14 onward links and 2 fan-in alerts. Everything below holds only for this dataset as this run processed it.

Alert fan_in:A-9278:1794301200000: account A-9278, window 1794301200000–1794304800000 ms, 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 357000 minor units. The contributing transfers are T0002, T0003, T0006, T0010, T0011 and T0012.
Alert fan_in:A-9895:1794319200000: account A-9895, window 1794319200000–1794322800000 ms, 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 15000 minor units. The contributing transfers are T0035 to T0040.

Onward links from the A-9278 alert: chains go at most 3 links deep. T0002, T0003 and T0006 each link to T0007 (A-9278 to A-5092, 138000), then to T0008 (A-5092 to A-2897, 135000), then to T0009 (A-2897 to A-4989, 132000). T0010, T0011 and T0012 each link to T0014 (A-9278 to A-5092, 210000), then to T0015 (to A-2897, 206000), then to T0016 (to A-4989, 202000). Every contributing transfer is passed on. The only account where the money comes to rest is A-4989: T0009 and T0016 are not passed on. The route accounts are A-9278, A-5092, A-2897 and A-4989. A-4989 has no fan-in alert.

Onward links from the A-9895 alert: chains go at most 1 link deep. T0038, T0039 and T0040 each link to T0041 (A-9895 to A-1415, 14000). T0041 is not passed on, so the money comes to rest at A-1415. The other three contributing transfers (T0035, T0036, T0037) are not passed on and start no chain. The route accounts are A-9895 and A-1415.

Shared devices on the routes: for the A-9278 alert, device D-568 sent transfers from three route accounts: A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897. All six onward transfers (T0007, T0008, T0009, T0014, T0015, T0016) were sent from D-568. The resting account A-4989 sent no transfers. For the A-9895 alert, no device was used by two or more of its route accounts (A-9895 sent from D-699, A-1415 from D-785).

What distinguishes the two alerts: both have 6 senders and 6 transfers, but they differ in four recorded ways. (a) Total: 357000 against 15000. (b) Pass-on: all 6 credits to A-9278 are passed on, against 3 of 6 for A-9895. (c) Depth: chains of 3 hops through A-5092 and A-2897 to A-4989, against 1 hop to A-1415. (d) Devices: one device, D-568, sends from every forwarding account on the A-9278 route, while no device is shared on the A-9895 route. The A-9278 indicator therefore comes with a recorded multi-hop, single-device forwarding structure. The A-9895 indicator has only a single partial forward and no shared device on its route.

A-1415 later sends T0055 (90000 to A-9514, device D-785) at 1794333900000. That is 11,700,000 ms after T0041, beyond the 1,800,000 ms onward gap, so the run recorded no onward link and T0041 counts as not passed on. A-1415 has no fan-in alert.

hypotheses.statement: One device (D-568) sending from A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897, with each hop forwarding slightly less than it received within minutes, fits these accounts being controlled by one operator and used as pass-through (layering) accounts toward A-4989. The data does not establish control, ownership or intent.

The A-9895 alert (six identical 2500 credits, half of them forwarded in one 14000 debit, no shared device on the route) may be benign collection, such as a shared bill or group payment. Or it may be a low-value mule test. The recorded relationships are weaker than for A-9278 and do not decide between these readings.

unresolved.question: What happens to funds at A-4989 after T0009 and T0016? A-4989 sends nothing in this bounded dataset, and activity outside the replay cannot be seen.

Is T0055 (A-1415 to A-9514, 90000), sent outside the onward gap and for more than A-1415 received through T0041, related to the A-9895 alert at all? Where did the rest of the 90000 come from? The dataset records no link.
Who uses device D-568, and what is the relationship between the accounts that share it? The data records only that transfers were sent from it.
Where did the 7500 minor units credited to A-9895 by T0035–T0037 go? They are not passed on within the gap, and the data does not show where they ended up.
